bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The biggest storyline continues to be the Jeffery Simmons trade, as the All-Pro defensive tackle has been settling in after Chicago traded two first-round picks for Simmons , with reports noting he wasn't happy with the Tennessee Titans about the trade after it happened, but he's still thrilled to be in Chicago . Meanwhile, the Bears enter their bye week riding high after a strong start, as the team is 7-2 at the bye, their best start through nine games since 2012 , with an NFL executive explaining why Chicago is now favored to win the NFC North.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions beat the New England Patriots in Munich, Germany in Week 10, with standout performances including Jahmyr Gibbs' 28-yard TD run aided by Penei Sewell's pull block and Gibbs' 12th touchdown of the 2026 season breaking a tie with Kenneth Walker III atop the current leaderboard . The biggest concern from the game was that Aidan Hutchinson suffered a knee injury on a post-sack celebration against the Patriots , casting a shadow over an otherwise strong defensive effort that included Brian Branch's big hit preventing a potential third-down conversion and Roger McCreary's first interception as a Lion .

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers activated running back Chris Brooks and wide receiver/kick returner Skyy Moore from injured reserve ahead of their pivotal Week 10 showdown against the Minnesota Vikings at Lambeau Field. The team also released wide receiver Coleman Owen in a corresponding roster move, while several other players, including safety Xavier McKinney, remain questionable for Sunday's divisional matchup.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The biggest story surrounding the Vikings is their Week 10 matchup against the Packers, with Kirk Cousins, newly reacquired via trade from the Raiders, starting at quarterback for Minnesota . The team faces additional challenges heading into Green Bay, as linebacker Blake Cashman is in concussion protocol, a potential problem for the defense , and Jordan Addison may be unavailable for the game after a new injury .
